entries.body:
Per-referred-user wager-saving detector on creators/[id] (owner spec).
For each user under the creator's code: deposits, non-borrowed wager
(per game), expected house GGR (wager × blended edge — packs 10.8%,
battles 10.8%, upgrader 10%, weighted by the user's game mix), actual
realised house PnL (coverage-attributed deposits − attributed card/voucher
withdrawals — same per-user formula as the creator PnL panel), the
deviation gap, and a risk flag/score; worst-first, default flag at a 50%
shortfall.

Reuses the canonical creator attribution model (acu wager — borrow-
correction already baked in; covering-creator deposit reconstruction;
session-chain card withdrawals). Per-game split via acu.game_session_id
→ game_sessions.game_type. LAZY (scans only when the tab is opened),
cached prod-pinned + timeout-guarded; MAIN/prod game DB read-only.

DATA GAP (verified read-only on prod): the behavioural high-win-chance
(~90%) upgrader signal needs per-bet target-multiplier data, but upgrader
is not live on prod (game_type enum is {pack,battle}; no upgrader sessions;
no upgrader_games table). The signal box reports this honestly and
self-enables once upgrader ships (reads the canonical
provably_fair_results.result_metadata target multiplier). Low-variance
abuse is still caught by the expected-vs-actual PnL gap, which doesn't
depend on upgrader.

New server-only integration layer under src/lib/creator-hub/ that the Hub's
Kick/Twitter tabs + the "Creator Check" recon tool call. Implements the RECON
API blueprint and the owner's STRICT no-spam caching contract.

- cache.ts   — RapidAPI key reads from admin_settings (server-only, masked at
  the UI boundary, never in client payloads); per-resource TTL + min-interval
  throttle (shouldFetch gate is the ONLY path that hits the API); handle
  normalization (handles/@/profile URLs); brand-keyword matcher + 7d window.
- kick.ts    — host kick-com-api.p.rapidapi.com: profile (/api/v1/channels/{slug},
  followersCount + nested user{profile_pic,bio,...} + live status), past streams
  (/api/v2/channels/{slug}/videos → kick_streams), current live
  (/api/v1/channels/{slug}/livestream). Profile = fetch-once/manual-Refetch;
  streams = served-from-DB within TTL.
- twitter.ts — host twitter241.p.rapidapi.com: profile (/user?username → rest_id

  it isn't re-resolved), defensive GraphQL-timeline walk, 7-day brand-mention
  scan (packydotgg/@packydotgg/packygg/packy.gg) counted from precomputed
  tweets.mentions_us. Feeds the cross-handle twitter_mentions ledger.
- index.ts   — clean typed barrel + runCreatorCheck() (one-shot both-platform
  fetch for Creator Check; parallel, per-platform graceful degrade).

No loops, no pollers, no per-render fetch — every call is TTL/throttle-gated and
wrapped in the safe-query withTimeout so a stuck upstream degrades to cache. A
missing key returns NO_KEY_CONFIGURED (graceful), never throws. Persists to the

entries.body:
Rework /insights/system-edge-plan into a complete edge/reward planner so the
owner can model future updates and see the projected profit impact (read-only,
no live data writes). Every lever is seeded from REAL production config and the
projection holds wager at observed volume so deltas are pure config effects.

Levers (all wired on real data unless noted):
- House edge SEPARATE per game type (packs / battles / upgrader). Per-type
  wager/payout/edge come from a new per-type split of the canonical gaming legs
  built with the EXACT canonical scope + borrow/reward filters, so the three
  types sum to the headline GGR by construction (verified: Σ per-type wager ==
  combined wager exactly). Upgrader surfaces but labels "not yet wired" on a
  pre-upgrader DB (upgrader_games absent) rather than inventing a number.
- Rakeback: per-cadence rates (real rakeback_config) + pack/battle vs upgrader
  wager weighting + an instant-claim payout-%/adoption control.
- Deposit bonus: match % / cap / min deposit / wager requirement (proportional
  cost effects; cap/window are backend-enforced per the discovery).
- Raffle: prize pool / draw frequency / ticket cost.
- Packs: daily/free pack value + frequency (real giveaway cost) and signup
  grant (real avg from getSignupOverview).
- Rain: net house slice (real max(0, rain_win - rain_tip)).
- Affiliate: per-tier commission % (real affiliate_level_configs) + the
  1x-wager-requirement toggle (modeled as a labeled what-if uplift).

Model (pure, serializable _model.ts): GGR_type = edge_type x wager_type;

The owner wanted the per-box timing readouts gone (not reworked). Rip out the
entire per-box load-time display system from /dashboard and un-pad the boxes so
they render normally again.

- Remove every <BoxLoadTime> badge and unwrap all <BoxTimingFrame> wrappers in
  page.tsx (KPI strip, the 3 today-cards, upgrader panel, wager-attribution, and
  every Trends chart) so the cards/charts render directly with no badge + no
  wrapper div. h-full stays where the 50/50 row needs it (the panels/cards are
  themselves h-full, so layout is unchanged).
- Remove the BOX_TIMING_RESERVE (pb-5) bottom-reserve strip from every CardContent
  that carried it (KpiPanel + the 3 today-cards). That padding only existed to
  clear the badge - dropping it un-pads the boxes so they look normal again.
- Hero chip: LoadTimeIndicator is now freshness-only. Dropped the queryMs perf
  number; kept the "Updated {relative}" data-freshness label as a clean pill
  (Clock icon). Still ticks every 30s; still SSR-formatted to avoid hydration #418.
- Remove the now-dead plumbing: the per-window timings object + type in
  kpi-window-data.ts, the snapshot timings block + the loadMs props in
  dashboard-kpi-section.tsx (KpiPanel loadMs param gone too), and the per-fetch
  performance.now()/Date.now() measurements in page.tsx that only fed badges.
- Delete the unused exports from load-time-indicator.tsx (BoxLoadTime,
  BoxTimingFrame, BOX_TIMING_RESERVE, formatBoxLoadMs) - only LoadTimeIndicator
  remains. Drop the now-unused imports across the dashboard files.
- dashboard.ts: comment-only - the timings map is retained for the /system/stats
  observability surface (no longer consumed by the dashboard UI); query logic
  untouched.

No box data/queries, no today/24h toggle behavior, no merged Wager box content,
and no house-POV colors were changed. tsc + lint (0 new warnings) + next build all
green.
